title: Pickle Ball Avatar
style: Jazz-pop phonk with swung half-time drums, rubbery sub-bass, brushed snare snaps, and a smoky minor-key piano loop; verse stays lean with close-mic vocals and clipped ad-libs, pre-chorus opens with filtered chops and rising chrome swells, chorus hits with stacked doubles and chanty gang responses, bridge drops to dry keys and a lone vocal before the last lift. Vinyl crackle, glitchy paddle taps, and tape-stop transitions; glossy, punchy mix with a dark velvet edge., jazz, bright, pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came in for a game
Left with a new name
Get the best paddle
From the pick a pick paddle riddle

Found my feet in the court dust
In my new pickle shoes
Bright blue pickle socks
Pink drink pickle hat on me too

You want it, I got it
I got that
Lined up at the edge
Now I step into the snap

[Pre-Chorus]
The serve gets close
My mind goes still
Hands on the grip
Heart on the drill

The sport is encumbering me
And I let it
Skin to the bounce
Yeah, I accept it

[Chorus]
Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
I am one with the ball
I am one with the ball

Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
We together are one
We together are one

[Verse 2]
Tennis to pickle ball pro
Watch the old frame change
Same body, new code
Same name, rearranged

I used to chase the edge
Now I move like a prayer
Soft knees, sharp turn
Like I was always there

Synchronisation matrix
Upgrade complete
Every little choice now
Clicks under my feet

[Pre-Chorus]
The crowd gets small
The court gets wide
I hear my breath
And I answer inside

No split between
The player and play
One clean motion
I’m made that way

[Chorus]
Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
I am one with the ball
I am one with the ball

Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
We together are one
We together are one

[Bridge]
I used to think I was holding on
Now I know what I was holding was gone
The paddle, the bounce, the bright blue thread
The game got in
And it moved my head

Now I don’t chase it
I don’t resist
I say yes
To the wrist, to the twist

[Chorus]
Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
I am one with the ball
I am one with the ball

Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
We together are one
We together are one
